fields.Name: T256 - Cluster Analysis Generation
fields.Description: Exercises the cluster-generation pipeline (OnRunClustering) and the scatter/metrics rendering with its run-error handling — distinct from the tag-cloud and other visualization code.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo), open 'Visualize' and select the 'Clusters' mode. Use the floating cluster config panel to pick a source entity/document and click the control that runs the clustering (Run/Generate). Success is that the analysis kicks off — a loading state on the scatter area appears and then a scatter plot with cluster metrics (Records / Clusters / Silhouette) renders, OR a clear run-error banner explains why (e.g. multi-entity embedding mismatch). You do NOT need to save the visualization. Also confirm the 'Saved Visualizations' sidebar is present. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Clusters view shows a config panel, a scatter area, and a 'Saved Visualizations' sidebar
Running clustering produces a loading state then a scatter plot + metrics, OR a clear run-error banner (a valid empty/no-data state also counts)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
